existing_overlap: No existing published article defines AGI; ai-glossary-50-terms has no AGI entry. Neighbouring concepts are linked, not repeated: ai-term-artificial-intelligence, ai-term-benchmark, ai-term-ai-alignment, ai-hype-vs-reality-2026, ai-terms-index.
notes: Definitions are attributed to whoever wrote them; the article asserts no universal definition and makes no prediction of when AGI arrives. No model names, prices or leaderboard scores. The headline example (a 90 percent question-bank score) is a labelled hypothetical, not an observation. Only the single officially published sentence about expert-panel verification is used from the Microsoft/OpenAI agreement. Morris et al. was read in arXiv v5 (2025-09-24), where Level 4 is named Exceptional rather than Virtuoso. openai.com pages return 403 to curl and WebFetch and were read through Wayback snapshots; sources list the original URLs.
